narrator_hint: seventh-storyteller / ending routes: several characters; work out the speaker from context

rows.en:
"Huh? Hino★"
Hino ran off down the hallway, ignoring me as I tried to stop him.{p}

By the time I hurried out into the hallway, his back was just about to disappear at the far end of it.
There had definitely been another boy beside Hino.
That had to be Sakagami.
I missed seeing his face again.{p}

How am I ever going to meet him...?
Now that I think of it...
Hino said 'the last one' just now.
...Which means...
There must be a seven wonders interview after school today.
In the newspaper club room............{p}

...In the end, after school came around without my ever having met Sakagami once.
We both go to every class like we're supposed to, yet I never catch even a glimpse of his face.
On top of that, today was nothing but classes where boys and girls are split up, like home ec and P.E.
I can't help thinking it's some kind of conspiracy.{p}

But...
Apparently the second seven wonders interview is about to be held in the newspaper club room.
If I go there, I'm bound to meet Sakagami.
The same class...
The same club...
...And yet I can't even picture his face. That's definitely weird.
Today I'm going to see with my own eyes just what kind of person he is.
I pulled myself together with a firm look and headed for the newspaper club.{p}

Gloomy gray clouds blanketed the whole sky. It could have started raining at any moment.
Even the wind was muggy, clinging to my skin and refusing to let go.
...Just like that time.
Is it a rule that the weather is always like this on seven wonders days?{p}
While I was thinking about that, I reached the newspaper club.{p}

When I opened the club room door, twelve eyes turned on me all at once.
Six boys and girls sat around the big table in the middle of the club room.
...Really, every last detail was exactly the same as that time.
They were all unfamiliar faces...
...None of last time's members were here.
Well, never mind that. Where's Sakagami..........?{p}It looks like he isn't here yet.
I'll come back later
I'll wait here for a while

Oh well.
I'll wait here for a while.
...Though this time I'm not one of the participants, so I can't exactly take a seat and wait.
Whatever, I'll just wait standing up.{p}
I decided to stand beside the door and wait.{p}

And then...
"Um, aren't you going to take a seat?"
One of them asked me, almost in a murmur.
"Oh, I'm..."
The six of them were staring at me with puzzled faces.
"I'm... not the seventh one."
I got so nervous that it was all I could manage to say.
"Then you must be the newspaper club member who's going to hear our stories.
Hino told us about you.
He says you're the club's rising star."
One of them nodded, as if that settled it.{p}

"I heard about you too.
Let me see... Your name is Sakagami, isn't it?"
...What★
W-wait a minute!
"Heh heh heh heh...
I'm so pleased.
To think the one who came to interview us would be such a lovely boy."{p}

Me, Sakagami...?
A lovely boy...?
What is everyone saying★
Just then...
...What★
I was stunned when I saw my reflection in the window glass.
Reflected there was a boy in a white dress shirt.
I looked away in a panic, so I didn't get a good look at the face...
But that was definitely me.
What on earth has happened to me...?{p}

"Well then, shall we get started?"
Paying no attention to my confusion, the six began their scary stories of things that happened at school.
But the real seven wonders had already begun.
At least, inside me...
When this meeting is over, who on earth will I have become............{p}

"...All right.
Then I'll leave the manuscript here, so please make sure you read it later."
"Yeah, I know.
I'll read it, I promise."{p}

Reassured by his words, I left the club room.
...But I'd barely gone a few steps when the club room door opened,{p}

"Hey, {a}.
Come here a sec..."
...and Hino beckoned me over.
Has he read it already?
Full of excitement, I went back into the club room.{p}

I'd somehow lost all my enthusiasm.
Manuscript in hand, I trudged dejectedly to the door.
"...Goodbye."
I said it curtly and went out.{p}

...And just then, I heard Hino muttering to himself.
"If I'd known it would turn out like this, I should've had Sakagami do the interviews from the start..."
...Sakagami?
Who could that be?
Was there anyone like that in the newspaper club?
Hmm, I still don't really know everybody yet.{p}

"Actually, you see...
that article got scrapped."{p}

"What...?"
...Oh no!
Fukuzawa looked like she was about to cry.
I had no choice but to cover it up.
"J-just kidding!
It's a joke, a joke.
That thing...
Even I'm not really sure when it'll come out.
It might be tomorrow...
It might be five years from now...
Aha, ahahaha..."
"Five years...?"
"Hmm, or was it three years...
Ahaha...
W-well, I'm in a hurry, so I'll go on ahead.
...Bye!"{p}
I fudged it as best I could and dashed away from there.{p}

"Oh, that?
Geez, it was printed ages ago.
...You haven't seen it yet?
That's weird.
I'm sure it was posted on the bulletin board too...
Maybe somebody tore it down?"{p}

"Really...★"
"Y-yeah, really.
Hmm, I wonder if there are any copies left at the newspaper club...
I don't think there were any left.
I know...!
I'll go to the club room and check for you.
And if there aren't any left, you'll just have to give up.
Ahaha...
There probably weren't any left, so...
W-well, I'm in a hurry, so I'll go on ahead.
...Bye!"{p}
After rattling off a string of glib lines, I fled from there as fast as I could.{p}

"Ugh..."
Rubbing his back and legs, he raised his head...
...Oh no!
Our eyes met dead on.{p}

The moment they did, Arai's eyes lit up.
"{a}...
Thank goodness. I've been waiting for you."
...he said, pressing in close to me.
"{a}...
Is it true that our stories won't be made into an article?
Just now, I overheard Hino talking with someone.
That's a lie, isn't it★"
Arai's eyes were strangely bloodshot, glittering with an eerie light.
Is this what the face of someone possessed looks like?
My body was frozen with fear, yet my mind was idly thinking things like that.
But...
"{a}!"
...The instant Arai grabbed my arms, those thoughts flew right out of my head.{p}

Ugh, it hurts...!
It hurts...☆
Arai's fingers were digging into my skin.
Maybe his nails had pierced it; there was even a faint ooze of blood...
Where does he get that kind of strength...?
...Both my arms were going numb.
The pain was so sharp I couldn't even cry.
I felt like my whole body would come apart...☆
Why is this happening to me...★{p}
Thinking that, I started to get kind of angry.

"Let go of me already☆"
The instant I screamed it, I shoved Arai away with all my might.
Arai staggered and reeled backward, then fell onto the hallway floor again.
I never knew I had that kind of strength...
So it's true that anger can turn you into a different person.{p}

...Wait, this is bad.
If anyone saw me here like this, I'd be in big trouble.

The instant that thought struck me, I sprang to my feet and fled from there.
"Ah, {a}!
Please wait!
Please tell me it's a lie☆"{p}

...I'm sorry.
It's true...
I'm sorry...!
Apologizing in my heart, I desperately searched for somewhere to escape.
Somewhere...
Wasn't there anywhere I could be alone?
Somewhere.........{p}
It wasn't Arai's voice...
Turn around
Keep running
Who is it this time...?
I turned around fearfully.{p}

...What I saw was Shindo.
"What's wrong, rushing around like that...{p}

"What, you haven't heard yet?
You're as out of the loop as ever.
It's 'cause you're like that that the article you worked so hard to research got scrapped."
..........Gulp!
He already knows.{p}

"See, the thing is,
some guy who said he was a first-year in the newspaper club came by my place a while ago and spilled the whole story."
"What!"
...Who★
Who on earth would say something like that☆
"And then he asked me to please take part, since they're holding the meeting again..."
...Does that mean they're redoing the whole interview?
Nobody told me anything about that.
Does it mean I've got nothing to do with it anymore...★
"So...
Did you say yes?"
"Nah...
I haven't answered him yet.
The guy just did all the talking and took off.
What was his name...
Oh yeah, he said Sakagami.
You're in the newspaper club too, so you know him, right?
What a scatterbrain, huh?"{p}

...Sakagami?
Was there anyone like that in the newspaper club?
I've heard that name somewhere... but who was it?
If that person went and talked to Shindo, does that mean this Sakagami is the one doing the interviews?{p}

"It's nice of 'em to invite me, but I've got no plans to go.
I don't wanna pull any more dangerous stunts.
I'm sick and tired of the seven wonders.
So I've been looking for him to turn it down, but I can't find him anywhere.
{a}...
You're in the newspaper club too, right?
If you see Sakagami, tell him I said that."
"Huh? Shindo?"
"See ya. I'm counting on you."{p}

With that, Shindo gave my shoulder a couple of pats and walked off.
...Somebody named Sakagami.
I don't even know him...
I think Shindo's a pretty big scatterbrain himself...{p}...Anyway, maybe I should try looking for this Sakagami person.
I'll do that
On second thought, I'd better not

Yeah, I'll do that.
It's bugging me so much I can't stand it.
But come to think of it, I don't know a thing about Sakagami.
...For now, I'll try going to the newspaper club.{p}

I started down the stairs.
Just then...
"{b}..."
Suddenly, warm breath blew across the nape of my neck.
"Eek!"
A chill shot up my spine, my foot slipped, and my body was flung out into the air.{p}

Instead, I felt something soft and feathery wrap gently around me.
..........What?
What happened...?
...When I fearfully opened my eyes...?{p}

Right in front of me was a familiar, friendly smile!
"K-Kazama★"
"Hey, that was a close call.
Missing a step on the stairs... You're quite the little klutz, aren't you?"
Kazama was holding me in his arms like a princess, beaming.
...Did he just save me?
But wait a minute...
I didn't miss a step.
It happened because Kazama did something weird!{p}

"Say, {b}.
Running into each other here must be fate.
Let's go on a date, you and me."
"What are you talking about!
I've got more important things to deal with."
I shook off Kazama's arms and stood on the landing on my own two feet.{p}

"Ahaha...
Shy as ever, aren't you?"
Talking to this guy just wears me out.
"{b}...
Do you know what this spot is called?
It's called an 'odoriba,' a landing.
In other words, a place for 'odori'... for dancing.
Come on, you've gotta dance, baby."
"Wh-what?"
Why does this guy always march to his own drum?{p}

"Come on, music!
..........Zun-taka-tat-ta, tan-ta-tan.
Tan-tan-tat-tan, hm-hm-hmm-hm.........."
Humming a dubious tune, Kazama started doing some sloppy dance steps.
As I watched in a daze, he twirled round and round to the right, to the left, then hopped and bounced.
Nozomu Kazama..........
A great man, in more ways than one.
I tried to quietly slip away.
And then...{p}

"{b}, aren't you going to dance?
Come dance with me.
Don't worry.
I'll lead you perfectly!
...You can look for Sakagami after that, can't you?"
Honestly, Kazama...!
But...
...Wait a minute!
He definitely just said Sakagami.
I never said a single word to Kazama about him...★{p}

"Hey, Kazama!
Do you know Sakagami?"
"Now, now, that's naughty...
Saying another man's name while you're with me.
Are you trying to tease me like that?
But I won't lose.
Not even if my rival in love is your classmate Sakagami.
Heh, after all, there's nobody who can beat me!"
"My classmate...★"{p}
Leaving Kazama behind, I broke into a run.{p}

I pretended I hadn't heard the voice and tried to keep running.
I'd had enough of getting mixed up in more trouble.
But...
"Hey, {a}.
Hold on a second!"
The moment the voice called out, a hand shot out and grabbed me firmly by the shoulder.
...Geez!
Who is it★{p}

But then..........
No way, Arai's still there!
What do I do...
I'd better hide somewhere a little longer.
But where should I go...{p}

...That's it!
I just have to ask my friends!
"Hey...
Does anybody know Sakagami?"
I raised my voice and asked.
Loud enough to ring through the whole class...
And then...?
"Haven't seen him yet today."
"Isn't he just late?
He's been coming in late lately."
"Wow, {a}, is a guy like Sakagami your type?"
"You're both in the newspaper club, so you must need him for something, right?"{p}

...Sakagami's...
...Sakagami, honestly...
Everyone's voices came surging at me like a tidal wave!
Does everyone know Sakagami★
Am I the only one who doesn't...?
...Why?
...How come?{p}

"Oh, yes..."
...I know him.
That's what I'd been about to answer.
After all, he's my classmate and my clubmate. I'd be too embarrassed to admit I didn't even know Sakagami existed.
But at that very moment...{p}

"I hate liars."
...A voice I recognized spoke right by my ear.{p}

I spun around, but no one was there.
...Was I hearing things?
A chill crept down my spine.

...You're right, I'll stop lying.
I can't shake the feeling that that person is watching me from somewhere.
I just have to answer honestly.
And say it with a smile...{p}
I turned on my heel and started to leave.{p}
